1.consolidated_definition: Persona que administra o dirige una empresa o sociedad en posición inmediatamente inferior al gerente. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Véase manager. El manager o el assistant manager se reservará el derecho de admitir y/o rechazar cualquier informacion, foto o persona que no llene los requisitos y/o no mantenga las normas o reglas del Club (High School all over, PR, consultado 24-04-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Person who administers or directs a company or society in an immediately inferior position to the manager. Raw Anglicism, frequent. See manager. The manager or assistant manager reserves the right to admit and/or reject any information, photo, or person that does not meet the requirements and/or maintain the norms or rules of the Club (High School all over, PR, consulted 24-04-08).
